svg.title: JobLens AI — request flow in the local kind cluster
svg.desc: Browser → kubectl port-forward or kind port map → ingress-nginx → api-gateway nginx → services → data stores; side planes for delivery, DNS, observability and config; gaps A–H.

g.text: JobLens AI — how a request flows through the local kind cluster
Traced from infra/local-k8s/**, apps/*/chart/**, apps/api-gateway/nginx.conf.template and each service's src/index.ts · code-level trace, cluster was not running · 2026-09-30
side plane: delivery · DNS · metrics · config
gap found while tracing (list at the bottom)
red = can't work in k8s as configured
last line of deploy-local.sh — the “App” URL it prints
kubectl tunnels to ONE selected controller pod
host :80/:443 → kind node container :80/:443 → controller hostPort
→ reachable from your LAN too (unless firewalled)
installed from the unpinned ingress-nginx/main manifest · project retired Mar 2026
Ingress joblensai-unified (ns joblensai) · any host · path / (Prefix) → Service api-gateway:80 · no tls: block
annotations: proxy-body-size 50m · proxy-read/send-timeout 86400 · use-forwarded-headers (ConfigMap-only key → no effect)
upstream = the Service's pod endpoints (no service-upstream annotation) → pod-to-pod, skipping ClusterIP / kube-proxy
only node → controller lands here (manifest selects kubernetes.io/os: linux; ingress-ready=true label unused) · snippets allowed
Vault, Gitea and monitoring also live here → right column
straight to the api-gateway pod IP, port 80
Service api-gateway (ClusterIP :80) only supplies the endpoint list
nginx:1.28-alpine · nginx.conf.template → envsubst at start (only defined vars; an unset ${VAR} stays literal)
upstreams: server <svc>.joblensai.svc.cluster.local:<port> resolve; · resolver 10.96.0.10 valid=10s (kube-dns) → IPs re-resolved, no restart
No gateway auth check on these
only its own login page protects
and :80 is reachable from your LAN
(web has scrape annotations but no job)
UI at /glitchtip/, but it gets no events:
CONFIG · how app pods get env
same keys everywhere: JWT private key,
Razorpay + LLM keys reach even web
api-gateway: plain env from its values only
OUTSIDE THE CLUSTER · pods call these directly
which provider is used: not traced
GAPS FOUND WHILE TRACING · read from code unless marked
gateway /api/agent/* → agent-service, which only serves /api/agent-service/* → every call 404s; its real routes fall through to the SPA. No client calls them yet.
backend mounts /api/job, but the gateway only forwards ~ ^/api/(account|file) → /api/job/* lands on the SPA. Frontend calls are still TODO(api).
RustFS unused — S3 goes to AWS
the S3 client reads AWS_S3_ENDPOINT; seed-vault + ExternalSecret only carry S3_ENDPOINT, and .dockerignore keeps .env out of images → uploads target real AWS S3.
SENTRY_DSN is in packages/shared/.env but never seeded or synced → initSentry() logs “Error tracking disabled” and returns, in every service.
Admin routes can't work in k8s
no mongo-express / kafka-ui / redis-insight Services here; LOCAL_AWS_UI_URL unset, so envsubst leaves ${LOCAL_AWS_UI_URL} literal. Likely 502s (not observed live).
Admin UIs reachable from the LAN
admin routes skip auth_request, and kind publishes :80/:443 on 0.0.0.0 → GlitchTip login page reachable from other machines (unless firewalled).
unpinned main manifest of a project retired Mar 2026 (no more security fixes); use-forwarded-headers as an annotation has no effect; snippets on, validation off.
all 6 app pods — even the static web nginx — envFrom the same joblensai-secrets, so JWT private key, Razorpay secret and LLM keys are everywhere.

General mechanics checked against: kind configuration docs · ingress-nginx annotations, ConfigMap and kind deploy.yaml (main) · nginx.org upstream … resolve and auth_request · docker-nginx 20-envsubst-on-templates.sh ·

kubernetes.io Service, DNS for Services and Pods, ClusterIP allocation, Ingress NGINX retirement (Nov 2025) · kubectl port-forward --help · Medium (read in full): R. Mane, Jul 2025; Unni P, Apr 2023 — both simplify ingress → ClusterIP.
